note: chatbi SQL 语义 lint 用例。每条给一段 SQL + 期望（clean=true 应无 fail；fails_with 关键词应命中 fail）。✅/❌ 成对覆盖 4 个检查项。

cases.sql: SELECT tm, rz FROM st_rsvr_r WHERE stcd = (SELECT code FROM att_st_base WHERE name LIKE '%XX%' AND deleted=0 LIMIT 1) AND tm > NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND deleted=0
SELECT tm, rz FROM st_rsvr_r WHERE eq_id = 1024 AND tm > NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND deleted=0
SELECT s.name, r.rz FROM st_pptn_r r JOIN att_st_base s ON r.stcd = s.code WHERE r.deleted=0
SELECT e.name FROM eq_equip_base e JOIN eq_equip_offline_record o ON e.code = o.equipment_code WHERE o.deleted=0 AND e.deleted=0
SELECT c.tm FROM stats_data_collection_daily c LEFT JOIN stats_data_missing_daily m ON c.tm=m.tm WHERE m.deleted=0 AND c.deleted=0
SELECT name FROM eq_equip_base WHERE status=0 AND deleted=0 AND tenant_id=1
SELECT s.name, r.z FROM st_river_r r JOIN att_st_base s ON r.stcd=s.code WHERE r.z > 3.5 -- 警戒水位
SELECT name FROM att_st_base WHERE id IN (SELECT 汛限水位 FROM st_rsvr_r)
SELECT tm, rz FROM st_rsvr_r WHERE rz > (SELECT extend_value FROM ew_info_rules WHERE ew_type='2' AND level_r='1') AND deleted=0
SELECT * FROM st_pressure_r WHERE deleted=0 LIMIT 100
SELECT tm, water_pressure FROM st_pressure_r WHERE eq_id=1024 AND tm > NOW()-INTERVAL 7 DAY AND deleted=0 ORDER BY tm
